# manifold

Manifold learning and embeddings: classical and metric or non-metric MDS (SMACOF, a Guttman transform per step), Isomap, locally linear embedding, Laplacian eigenmaps and diffusion maps, t-SNE, UMAP, self-organising maps, and the measures of embedding quality (trustworthiness, continuity, the co-ranking matrix). The algorithms that produce an embedding observe it at every step as the `embedding` tensor.

- estimator `isomap`: Isomap embedding from geodesic distances. `src/lib/manifold/isomap.ts:91` `mdml-engine/manifold`
- estimator `mds`: Metric and non-metric multidimensional scaling (SMACOF). `src/lib/manifold/mds.ts:277` `mdml-engine/manifold`
- estimator `selfOrganisingMap`: Self-organising map. `src/lib/manifold/som.ts:207` `mdml-engine/manifold`
- estimator `tsne`: t-SNE embedding, one gradient step at a time. `src/lib/manifold/tsne.ts:637` `mdml-engine/manifold`
- estimator `umap`: UMAP embedding. `src/lib/manifold/umap.ts:345` `mdml-engine/manifold`
